briefTitle: A Study to Investigate Ubamatamab With and Without Marlotamig (REGN7075) in Adult Participants With Advanced/Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

typedChecks.sourceText: Has histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of advanced (stage IIIB not amenable to definitive chemoradiotherapy or stage IIIC) or metastatic (stage IV) NSCLC
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Has histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of advanced (stage IIIB not amenable to definitive chemoradiotherapy or stage IIIC) or metastatic (stage IV) NSCLC

typedChecks.sourceText: Has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1

typedChecks.sourceText: Has untreated or active primary brain tumor, Central Nervous System (CNS) metastases, leptomeningeal disease, or spinal cord compression, as described in the protocol
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Has untreated or active primary brain tumor, Central Nervous System (CNS) metastases, leptomeningeal disease, or spinal cord compression, as described in the protocol

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received appropriate first line standard of care treatment for advanced or metastatic NSCLC, as described in the protocol
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior line requirements are general and reference protocol specifics rather than a strict numeric minimum or maximum line count.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: If platinum doublet chemotherapy was not administered as first line therapy, it is required in a later line of therapy prior to enrollment unless there is a documented reason why it is not appropriate
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior platinum requirement contains conditional exceptions and protocol discretion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has tumor tissue (archival or fresh) available for testing MUC16 expression by immunohistochemistry inclusion (IHC), as described in the protocol
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Testing availability requirement for MUC16 expression without a specific numerical threshold is not a typed biomarker check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has at least 1 radiographically measurable lesion by Computed Tomography (CT) or Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) per RECIST v1.1 criteria. Target lesions may be located in a previously irradiated field if there is documented (radiographic) disease progression in that site
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has progression of disease fewer than 84 days from starting initial anti-Programmed Cell Death (PD)-(L) 1 therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Time-based disease progression window following specific prior therapy is a complex rule not mapped to a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Current participation OR past participation in another investigational study in which an investigational intervention (eg, drug, vaccine, invasive device) was administered within 4 weeks before planned first dose of study intervention in this clinical study
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window for investigational study participation is not a simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received prior monoclonal antibody against PD-(L)1 within 21 days of the first dose of study intervention
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window for specific drug class is not a simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has had other prior anti-cancer immunotherapy within 21 days prior to study intervention, as described in the protocol
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window for prior immunotherapy is not a simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received prior cytotoxic chemotherapy within 21 days of the first dose of study intervention
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window for cytotoxic chemotherapy is not a simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has received an anti-EGFR antibody therapy within the following drug-specific window prior to first dose of study intervention (approximately 5 half-lives), as described in the protocol
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window based on half-lives is not a simple lab cutoff.
